params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repoPath=Join-Path $HOME 'HeavenBridgeRepo'; git -C $repoPath fetch origin fix/updater-e2e-heaven-runner-20260929 --quiet; $sha=(git -C $repoPath rev-parse origin/fix/updater-e2e-heaven-runner-20260929).Trim(); $wt=Join-Path $HOME ('mhw-pr148-build-'+$sha.Substring(0,10)); if(Test-Path $wt){git -C $repoPath worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $wt -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}; git -C $repoPath worktree add --detach $wt $sha | Out-Null; Push-Location $wt; try {;   $v=(& dotnet --version).Trim(); Write-Output ('SOURCE_SHA='+$sha); Write-Output ('DOTNET='+$v);   dotnet restore .\tests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests.csproj -p:NuGetAudit=false;   if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE};   dotnet build .\tests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests.csproj -c Release --no-restore -p:NuGetAudit=false;   if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE};   Write-Output 'BUILD=PASS'; } finally { Pop-Location }
